message.content: {"rules":["For safety, considering only the data pointers and ignoring metadata for non-Sized pointees, self and origin must either point to the same address, or both be derived from a pointer to the same allocated object with the entire memory range between them in bounds of that object. This requirement applies both at runtime and during const evaluation.","For safety, the distance between the data pointers of self and origin, in bytes, must be an exact multiple of size_of::<u8>(), which is 1 byte.","For safety, the absolute distance between the data pointers of self and origin, in bytes and computed on mathematical integers without wrapping, must not exceed isize::MAX; this follows from the same-address or same-allocation in-bounds requirement."]}
